title.narrative: Life-Saving IDP and Famine Response in Northern State: Addressing Urgent Needs in AlDaba, Golid, Burgaig, and Dongola

description.narrative: ltpgtRelief International (RI) and its partners Auttash Organization for Peace and Development (APD) and NADA Elazhar For Disaster Prevention and Sustainable Development (NADA) aim to address urgent health, nutrition, and protection needs in AlDaba, Golid, Bargaige, and Dongola localities of Northern State, where communities face severe health gaps and famine conditions. The project will expand access to healthcare, nutrition, and protection services, while mainstreaming WASH interventions. It will strengthen primary healthcare, including emergency trauma care and outbreak response, in collaboration with the State Ministry of Health (SMoH), focusing on diseases such as measles, malaria, and cholera. Integrated Community Case Management (iCCM) will ensure early diagnosis and treatment of common diseases at the community level, while AlGabah Hospital in AlDaba locality will receive support to sustain secondary care. ltbrgtThrough this intervention, RI and partners will reach 63,222 people (13,338women, 20,093 girls, 10,485 men, 19,305 boys) with health services33,437 people (5,199 women,13,085 girls, 2,581men,12,572 boys) with nutrition activities and 22,441 people (8511 women, 5330 girls,4185 men, 4415 boys) with protection services. ltbrgtAPD will directly implement services in 11 health facilities while RI provides technical oversight, support, and monitoring to ensure delivery of quality integrated care. Facilities include: Al-Afaz PHC/Alafaad, Al-Sayal Family Health Center, Al-Gabah Hospital, Argee South, and Hamadab Village No. 3 PHCs (AlDaba) Biuoud Abu Jijar PHC (Bargaige) Al-Gadar and Arbi PHCs (Golid) and Kaltous, Jazirat Arbis, Al-Hulur PHCs (Dongola). Each will deliver a comprehensive primary health care package, including OPD consultations, reproductive health (antenatal, postnatal, family planning, skilled birth attendance), mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS), immunization and outbreak response, strengthened referral pathways, and community health promotion. ltbrgtFor nutrition, a full CMAM package will be provided in five facilities in Dongola and Golid. RI will manage community-level activities, while APD will focus on facility-based interventions. Nutrition support will include early detection and referral of malnutrition cases, integrated screening campaigns, and Infant and Young Child Feeding (IYCF) campaigns to create demand and raise awareness. WASH kits will be distributed to SAM cases to address hygiene needs and improve health outcomes. At the community level, RI will implement iCCM through trained Community Health Workers (CHWs) linked to facilities for supplies and patient referrals. WASH services will be mainstreamed into health and nutrition programming. ltbrgtProtection interventions will address the needs of vulnerable populations, especially women and girls. RI will establish safe spaces, enhance GBV and MHPSS services, and deliver structured psychosocial support for distressed children. Parenting programs will target caregivers to promote a protective environment for children. Specialized case management will support at-risk children and GBV survivors, while community-based protection networks (CBPNs) will be strengthened to improve resilience and safety through a community-driven, gender-sensitive approach. ltbrgtConflict sensitivity will be integrated across all project activities in line with the “do no harm” principle. RI will conduct conflict analyses, ensure transparent and inclusive beneficiary selection, engage meaningfully with communities, and carry out regular risk assessments. By collaborating closely with authorities and local stakeholders, RI will foster peace and stability while delivering timely, needs-based support. Risk mitigation will be reinforced through staff training, strong monitoring and evaluation, community feedback mechanisms, and adaptive programming. These measures will ensure that health, nutrition, and protection services are provided effectively without fueling local tensionsltbrgtlt/pgt
